parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The agent ID assigned by CNNIC after real-name authentication. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name authenticated registrant.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end time of the query (timestamp).

parameters.name: OperationType
parameters.description: The operation type of the Operation logs log record, such as modifying an agent.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start time of the query (timestamp).
